call_points.text: No FY27 revenue or margin guidance; management gave only direction on four growth levers: CASA, liabilities, AePS and CMS.
SFB ROE target of 20% is aimed at FY30, built on an asset-light model and ~300 bps cost-of-funds advantage.
FY26 lending referral disbursals about ₹1,300 Cr, with Q4 at ₹592 Cr, up 97% QoQ; earns about 100 bps.
Margins expanded 250 bps QoQ and 500 bps for the full year as the mix shifts to CASA and ownership business.
Capital adequacy at 83% against 15% required; SFB launch does not need fresh capital under the FY30 business plan.
Cost of funds below 2% on core CASA; about ₹2,800 Cr of low-cost liabilities entering the SFB phase.
UPI P2M business paused; existing merchants cannot transact and no new onboarding until the review completes.
Business correspondent business, about ₹140 Cr of FY26 revenue, cannot continue in an SFB; strategic options being explored.
Fit-and-proper review of the unavailable MD is work in progress with the board; a special review of the product and process in contention is ongoing.

guidance.statement: Aim to achieve 20% ROE by FY30 under the SFB business plan
About ₹100 Cr technology capex over and above core banking

operating_notes.text: Bank received in-principle approval from RBI on December 5, 2025, to transition into a Small Finance Bank.
FY26 CASA revenue was ₹630 Cr, of which ₹136 Cr was float income.
CASA subscription renewal run rate maintained at 60-65%.
About 20.84 lakh physical merchants cover 98% of pin codes; Soundbox deployed to 2,951 merchants as a data strategy, not revenue.
April 2026 average total deposits stood at ₹2,801 Cr with loan referral disbursals at ₹166 Cr.
Mr. Rishi Gupta ceased to be MD & CEO effective May 21, 2026, after opting for voluntary early retirement.
Entered into a strategic partnership with Ezee.ai for deployment of an AI-enabled Loan Origination System (LOS), Business Rules Engine (BRE) and Collections Management Platform.
May 2026 average total deposits stood at ₹2,762 Cr and loan referral disbursals at ₹210 Cr.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): interest earned ₹64.1 Cr (+21.4% YoY), net profit ₹7.1 Cr (-70.4% YoY).
2026-05-04: Q4FY26 earnings call transcript — deposits at all-time high ₹2,957 Cr, UPI P2M paused, no FY27 guidance, SFB ROE target of 20% by FY30 reiterated.
Fino Payments Bank reported April 2026 average total deposits of ₹2,801 Cr (+13% YoY) and loan referral disbursals of ₹166 Cr (+204% YoY).
Fino Payments Bank MD & CEO Rishi Gupta took voluntary early retirement, and the Board extended Mr. Ketan Merchant as Interim CEO.
Fino Payments Bank partnered with Ezee.ai on June 1, 2026, to deploy an AI-enabled lending and collections platform for its Small Finance Bank transition.
Fino Payments Bank reported May 2026 loan referral disbursals of ₹210 Cr (+186% YoY) and average total deposits of ₹2,762 Cr (+10% YoY).
Fino Payments Bank Limited’s **Basavraj Loni** announces earnings conference call on **October 30, 2026**, at 16:00 IST to discuss audited H1FY27 and Q2FY27 results.
